generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The logic for checking nested fields under index sort has been updated to be more specific, but it could benefit from a unit test that specifically checks this behavior with various nested structures and index sorts.

review_comment: I wonder how this works when the nested field is added as an update to the mapping? Should we always set the parent field in case a nested field is added later?
Good point, I was thinking about this but wasn't sure of the implications. @jpountz any thoughts on this?
I asked a similar question to @s1monw a while back, and he suggested always adding the parent field when an index sort is configured.
Excellent, this simplifies things. Lemme update the PR.
Maybe include the reason why parent field is always enabled in the comment too?
Right, this was added in the last iteration.
